ruleDefinitions.name: Browser Started with Remote Debugging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects browsers starting with the remote debugging flags. Which is a technique often used to perform browser injection attacks

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-remote\\-debugging\\-.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-start\\-debugger\\-server.*")))
